ex vivo IFN ELISpot assay.readouts: Ag85A-specific and PPD-specific IFN-γ spot-forming cells per million PBMC

evidence_location.quote: Both intradermal and intramuscular MVA85A induced high levels of Ag85A-specific IFN at the peak (day 7) time-point. The responses were durable, staying significantly above baseline six months post-vaccination

surface and intracellular cytokine stain.readouts: CD4+ T-cell cytokine production (IFNγ, TNFα, IL2), polyfunctional CD4+ T cells, and CD4+ T-cell chemokine receptor expression (CCR4, CCR6, CCR7, CXCR3)

evidence_location.quote: Both routes of vaccination induced significant IFN, TNFα and IL2 at weeks 1 and 24 post vaccination. Levels of produced cytokines between the two groups did not significantly differ at any time-point.

IgG enzyme linked immunosorbent assay (E.readouts: anti-r85A IgG levels as background-subtracted optical density (OD)

evidence_location.quote: Volunteers who were vaccinated intradermally with MVA85A had significantly higher serum IgG 4 weeks post-vaccination when compared to baseline (p = 0.0342) and week-2 (p = 0.0005).
